usageNotes: Creates a new cluster-level firewall security group, which acts as a named, reusable set of firewall rules that can be referenced in VM, container, or host firewall policies. Requires the `Sys.Modify` privilege at the root (`/`) path — API tokens must have this privilege explicitly granted. The `rename` parameter doubles as an update path: POST with `rename` set to an existing group name and `group` set to the new name (or the same name to update only the comment) to rename or annotate an existing group without deleting it.

examples.summary: Create a security group for web-tier VMs allowing HTTP/HTTPS inbound

params.comment: Allow HTTP and HTTPS inbound for web-facing VMs

tips: Group names must start with a letter and can contain letters, digits, hyphens, and underscores (2–18 chars); plan a naming scheme before creating many groups.
Use the `digest` param when scripting bulk changes to detect race conditions — fetch the current digest from `get_cluster_firewall_groups` first.
Security groups created here are cluster-wide but contain no rules until you add them via the rule-creation endpoints (e.g., `post_cluster_firewall_groups_{group}_rules`).
To rename an existing group without losing its rules, POST with `rename` = current name and `group` = new name; rules are preserved under the new name.
